stages.note: Build + tests must pass. Hooks may dispatch a verification skill or run project-defined make/npm targets.
Reviewer resolved from implementer-reviewer-pairings (default: same-domain reviewer per routing-table).

condition.note: Project-defined: controllers, DTOs, guards, auth, frontend forms, config with secrets/CORS, package.json. Skip with N/A justification when no match.

stages.note: Auto-commit after all preceding gates pass. Push is never automatic; the user controls push.
